_doc: Repo defaults for the harness's numbers (resource_budget.LIMITS reads them; `ah limits show` prints the effective values). max_live_owners is THE owner cap per session: helpers, reviewers and testers are never counted. enforce=false: at the cap a short advisory; true: the spawn is denied. A local override (~/.agent-harness/limits.local.json, via `ah limits set`) may loosen freely; only the owner or a supervisor may tighten.
